applicability.evidence_scope: Source samples, not a platform-wide effectiveness claim.

exceptions: Do not use decorative numbers or suggest the creator owns a reference asset.
patterns.joint_expression: There is something concrete worth explaining.
patterns.name: Proof first
patterns.sound: State the result or explain the visible evidence; original sound is optional.
patterns.visual: An owned or authorized result, screenshot or object is readable in the first frame.

applicability.evidence_scope: Source samples, not a platform-wide effectiveness claim.

exceptions: Availability of a sample URL does not authorize reuse; the clip itself must communicate.
patterns.joint_expression: Look at this, then understand why it matters.
patterns.name: Original clip first
patterns.sound: Use relevant original sound, then enter with the explanation.
patterns.visual: Start with an authorized original clip; identify its subject and purpose.

applicability.evidence_scope: Source samples, not a platform-wide effectiveness claim.

exceptions: A greeting without a relevant situation is not the same mechanism.
patterns.joint_expression: A recognizable or real situation is already happening.
patterns.name: Borrowed sound
patterns.sound: Start with an authorized meaningful question, line, announcement or ambient event.
patterns.visual: Show the speaker or a reaction paired with the source; identify who/what is being heard.

applicability.evidence_scope: Source samples, not a platform-wide effectiveness claim.

exceptions: Keep comparison units and context comparable.
patterns.joint_expression: These similar things produced different results.
patterns.name: Side-by-side comparison
patterns.sound: Name the difference or ask its cause.
patterns.visual: Show two comparable states with readable, grounded labels.

applicability.evidence_scope: Source samples, not a platform-wide effectiveness claim.

exceptions: Readable placement and contrast matter more than font imitation.
patterns.name: Text as the visual
patterns.sound: Use clear speech or another intentional sound supporting the text.
patterns.visual: Make readable typography the focal element; time any reveal to actual words.

applicability.evidence_scope: Source samples, not a platform-wide effectiveness claim.

exceptions: Do not fill the whole diagram before it can be understood.
patterns.joint_expression: Follow a prepared explanation through the diagram.
patterns.name: Diagram above speaker
patterns.sound: Explain the currently visible part at the creator’s natural pace.
patterns.visual: Place the diagram or sequence above a small speaker window; reveal only the relevant part.

applicability.evidence_scope: Source samples, not a platform-wide effectiveness claim.

exceptions: A gesture added after the idea is gone does not establish first-frame alignment.
patterns.joint_expression: The action and words emphasize one idea.
patterns.name: Body expresses the word
patterns.sound: Use a matching line or precise sound cue.
patterns.visual: Begin already making a gesture or expression that communicates the opening idea.

applicability.evidence_scope: Source samples, not a platform-wide effectiveness claim.

exceptions: Do not invent assets or replace factual evidence with unrelated decoration.
patterns.joint_expression: Each assertion has something concrete to see.
patterns.name: Show the spoken object
patterns.sound: Speak clearly enough for the corresponding visual to be recognized.
patterns.visual: Display an available photo, object or screenshot when it is named.

applicability.evidence_scope: Source samples, not a platform-wide effectiveness claim.

exceptions: Novel naming is a creative proposal, not proof of an unmet audience need.
patterns.joint_expression: This gives a name to something I recognize.
patterns.name: Name a phenomenon
patterns.sound: Explain it in a fitting calm or animated voice.
patterns.visual: Use a short, legible name for a phenomenon familiar to the intended audience.

applicability.evidence_scope: Source samples, not a platform-wide effectiveness claim.

exceptions: Okay/So and first person are not automatic failures when the action carries meaning.
patterns.joint_expression: Someone is telling me something while doing it.
patterns.name: Speak mid-action
patterns.sound: State the point naturally; quiet, conversational delivery can work.
patterns.visual: Start mid-gesture, movement or an everyday action relevant to the creator.

applicability.evidence_scope: Source samples, not a platform-wide effectiveness claim.

exceptions: Specificity and clarity matter; a named entity alone does not prove a useful hook.
patterns.joint_expression: There is a specific fact to learn.
patterns.name: Concise factual opening
patterns.sound: Give a grounded fact or conclusion in a short first sentence.
patterns.visual: Show the subject or a readable subject label in a simple composition.

applicability.evidence_scope: Source samples, not a platform-wide effectiveness claim.

exceptions: Lack of text, face or speech is valid; whether suspense is understandable needs observation.
patterns.name: Action suspense
patterns.sound: Use intentional environmental sound, music or silence; speech is optional.
patterns.visual: Show an ongoing action whose possible outcome a viewer can understand.

applicability.evidence_scope: Source samples, not a platform-wide effectiveness claim.

exceptions: Overlay on another mode; consistency requires a prior episode to compare.
patterns.joint_expression: This is another installment of a familiar series.
patterns.name: Recognizable series layout
patterns.sound: Use a recognizable voice or available recurring sound.
patterns.visual: Reuse a purposeful first-frame layout while changing the current subject.

applicability.evidence_scope: Source samples, not a platform-wide effectiveness claim.

exceptions: Packaging is not verification of expertise or authority.
patterns.joint_expression: This has the recognizable form of a program.
patterns.name: Familiar media format
patterns.sound: Match the intended presentation without implying a false affiliation.
patterns.visual: Use a purposeful news, documentary, podcast or editorial composition.

applicability.evidence_scope: Source samples, not a platform-wide effectiveness claim.

exceptions: Overlay on another mode; transcript and loudness alone cannot establish heard tone.
patterns.joint_expression: The delivery establishes how this should feel.
patterns.name: Sound sets the emotion
patterns.sound: Use deliberate emphasis, calm certainty, intimate quiet or conversational energy.
patterns.visual: Let the first-frame visual support the intended emotional context.
